bio_en: Hovhannes Korkotian, called Korkot by his friends, was of Akhaltsikhe origin but born in Erzurum in 1868; he studied until fourteen and then learned gunsmithing from his father. In Tiflis he joined 'Vrezh', one of the ARF groups, and resolved to devote himself to the revolution. In 1895 he joined a group of operatives in Karin (Erzurum), where with one comrade he entered the prison and freed Arshak of Karabakh. Besieged by troops in a house that was set on fire, he refused to surrender and fell, struck by 23 bullets, at the age of 27; his comrade Martiros was killed soon after.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Source: 'In memory of Karin', ARF press, Vienna 1896. Death year from age 27 and 1895 activity.
